adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` is currently a no-op: it just `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)`, exactly like `#show`, and `@embedding` is an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding` (no persistence possible). The routes add `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`, and the Ember controller defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({});`, but the UI template (`admin/templates/embedding.hbs`) never invokes `saveChanges`, so this write endpoint/action appears unused and potentially misleading rather than an active functional defect.
